title: feat: category toggles with counts in key model picker
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
Restricting a key to one modality (e.g. text only) took five clicks through tabs and \"Clear shown\" / \"Select all shown\". The Generate row now has one toggle per category with a selected/total count, used by create key, edit key and app consent.

- Adds `All`, `Text`, `Image`, `Video`, … chips showing e.g. `Text 372/373`
- One click: an empty category fills; a full or partial one clears. Text only = `All` then `Text`
- Three looks: full = solid fill, partial = pale fill (`aria-pressed="mixed"`, new `TabButton` state), none = the standard unselected pill
- `All` works like a select-all checkbox: when partial, a click fills everything
- Counts reserve their widest width, so chips don't move while toggling
- `Choose models` keeps search and per-model picks; the duplicate category tabs are removed
- Fix consent: apps' requested models are a preselection again, not a hard limit, so users can add models (regressed in #15271). Selecting everything grants all models, same as dashboard keys
- Grants stay explicit model IDs (today's text models); no API or gen auth change

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Text-only key | 5 clicks, nothing says \"text only\" | 2 clicks: `All`, `Text` |
| Partial category | invisible until expanded | `7/20` on the chip |
| Consent screen | only the app's models, can't add | full catalogue, app's models preselected |

gist.headline: Two clicks to text only
gist.blurb: Model permissions get category toggles with counts, so a text-only key takes two clicks instead of five. The app consent screen gets the full model catalogue back, with the app’s requests already picked.
gist.summary: Added All and per-category model toggles with selected/total counts across key creation, key editing, and app consent; consent now preselects requested models without restricting users to them.
gist.impact: A text-only key takes two clicks instead of five, partial selections are visible on their category chips, and users can add models beyond an app’s initial request.
gist.visual_concept: Polli uses a tiny tool belt to tap chunky All and Text category chips on a retro key-permissions screen; a count on Text makes the selection visible. A friendly monitor robot holds the app’s preselected models beside an open catalogue, with code-plants and flowers around the workspace.
